content: 0.5's live probe, at the next build: on its own socket, a fresh session on a `low`-capable OpenAI model reports `low`, `/effort high` reports `high` and survives a resume, a worker spawned from it inherits `high`, and a config that still carries `provider.openai_reasoning_effort` or `agents.swarm_effort` starts clean and sets nothing. These are the effort items of the by-hand smoke list (`docs/dev/testing.md`); a draft driver (mock endpoint, ACP client, runner) is in `~/.kcode/scratch/probe-0.5/`.
note: gate half landed 2026-10-03: guardrails green; `scripts/test.sh full` green bar the three recorded `session_flow` reds; the touched crates' own suites green bar the recorded TUI and provider reds (`plans/test-tree.md`).
